sections: The learner practised JAWS. They used the links list (Insert+F7) successfully but struggled with headings navigation using the H key, repeatedly landing in forms mode.
The instructor demonstrated the virtual cursor toggle (Insert+Z) and guided headings navigation.
The learner's headings navigation improved by the end of the session.
Practise headings navigation on a news site for 15 minutes daily. Next week: tables.

homework.title: Headings practice
homework.instructions: Navigate a news site by headings for 15 minutes each day.
